summary: Search conversation messages and tool output, reveal matching rows, and load earlier history on demand

schema.detail: No wire or persistent schema changes.

rules.detail: No runtime or policy rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Web client behavior only. Cmd/Ctrl+F opens transcript search; pressing it again uses browser Find. Search includes mail subjects and rendered Markdown words, excluding formatting markers and hidden link destinations. Navigation waits for a matching row to mount without a deadline; changing the query navigates even within the same entry. Closing search or deactivating its pane restores disclosures opened only by search. Search reports loaded-history coverage and can fetch earlier history on request. Scrolling up loads earlier history without a permanent history band; failures wait for explicit Retry.

downtime.detail: No runtime deployment or migration changes.

recovery.detail: Reverting the web client restores the previous transcript history controls.
